conviction_note: Scale 13% (option event move 12.4%, a likely guidance change, last three prints -14/-18/-20); p_up 40 because the company's own H1 numbers make the low end of the FY26 $240-290m guide very hard to reach, so a cut or narrowing is likely, against a stock already at its 52-week low, -20% in 20 days, about 13% of float short and a single-source revenue bar. The findings sum (-3.7) and the scaled number (-2.6) agree in sign and size.

positioning_check: Short interest about 7.8m shares (about 13% of float), 6.5 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement (Curved Trading via search snippet; https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/vnda/short-interest/ returned 403). Equibles had 7.4m, 12.28% of float and 9.0 days to cover on 2026-08-20 (https://equibles.com/stocks/vnda/shortinterest). The short is crowded enough to shrink the negatives. The baseline has no skew (skew_25d null). Put/call open interest is 0.10 on 1,957 contracts, so the open interest leans to calls. The ATM spread is 50% of mid, so the implied move is indicative only. BlackRock filed a passive 13G for 5.9% (event 2026-09-30, filed 2026-10-27). No Form 4s since July.

findings.finding: Vanda's own H1 2026 numbers leave its FY26 guide very hard to reach, so a cut or narrowing is likely in this release. H1 revenue was $102.2m, so the $240-290m guide needs $137.8-187.8m in H2, about $69-94m a quarter, against ~$50.5m in Q2 plus the $7.0m HETLIOZ shift. Fanapt was $65.5m in H1, so its $150-170m line needs $84.5-104.5m in H2 (about $42-52m a quarter) against $36.0m in Q2. BYSANTI, which shares that line, has no launch announcement I could find, and its timing slipped from 'Q3' to 'second half'. NEREUS revenue was $1.0m and constrained, against a $10-30m line management called 'not informed by actual data'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q3 2025 (2025-10-29) Vanda narrowed revenue guidance to $210-230m from $210-250m and cut year-end cash guidance, and the stock moved -20.15% (https://seekingalpha.com/news/4510972-vanda-narrows-2025-revenue-guidance-to-210m-230m-amid-fanapt-growth-and-strategic-investments). On 2026-05-06 it raised the guide (adding NEREUS) and still moved -14.11%. On 2026-08-05 it reiterated the guide after a large revenue miss explained as timing, and moved +0.59%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -59% from its 52-week high, sits at its low and fell 20% in 20 days. But the sell-side has not marked to the arithmetic. Q3 revenue consensus of $68.2m sits near the low-end run-rate the guide implies, five analysts still rate it Buy with an $11.50 average target, and H.C. Wainwright reiterated $20 on 2026-10-05. If a cut were fully priced, Q3 consensus would sit near $60m and targets would have come down after Q2.
findings.independence: Q1 call (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/06/vanda-vnda-q1-2026-earnings-call-transcript/): NEREUS guide 'not informed by actual data', no BYSANTI revenue guidance, Fanapt down 11% sequentially in Q1. Shares the Q2 8-K/10-Q with finding 2.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue probably lands below the $68.2m consensus. Q3 carries the known $7.0m of HETLIOZ orders shipped 2026-06-29 that arrived 2026-07-01, but underlying HETLIOZ was $5.6m in Q2 after specialty-pharmacy destocking, and the 10-Q warns of further 'potentially significant' declines. Fanapt TRx grew 31% y/y in Q2, so Q3 Fanapt is about $38-41m. NEREUS revenue was constrained in Q2 on wholesaler inventory, and BYSANTI had no announced launch. My build is about $60-67m, which would make a fifth straight revenue miss (Benzinga's table shows four).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-05 Q2 revenue of $50.5m missed about $62m consensus by roughly 19%, with the $7m explained as timing, and the stock moved +0.59%. Revenue misses alone have been forgiven when explained. The large down moves (-14% to -20%) came on prints that carried guidance or cash changes.
findings.why_not_priced: The only revenue consensus I could source ($68.2m) sits above a bottom-up build from the company's own Q2 product lines. If the market had priced a miss, the published consensus would be near $60-63m. The bar has one source, so this finding is capped small.
findings.independence: Shares the Q2 release and 10-Q with finding 1. The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001347178/000162828026053855/vnda-20260630.htm) gives the HETLIOZ destocking and the NEREUS constraint.

findings.finding: Two positive Phase III readouts came in September and October and the stock did not reward either. On 2026-10-27 NEREUS (tradipitant) cut semaglutide-associated vomiting to 43.0% vs 58.5% on placebo (p=0.006), with an sNDA planned. The stock closed +1.3% on about 2x volume (3.94 to 3.99) and gave it back on 2026-10-28 (3.92). HETLIOZ in delayed sleep phase disorder was positive on 2026-09-29 (n=43, p=0.022), and the stock moved -2.4% that day. On the call, management could size the GLP-1 opportunity, give an sNDA timeline and update NEREUS promotion plans.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has not paid for pipeline news: +1.3% on a positive Phase III that faded, -2.4% on a positive Phase III, and -1.9% on the 2026-10-14 VQW-765 failure. The prints have traded on commercial numbers and cash.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The data is public and the stock barely moved. Only on-call framing (an sNDA date, a promotion plan, any demand data) would be new.
findings.independence: Price tape, Yahoo chart (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/VNDA?range=1mo&interval=1d): the 10-27 close at 3.99 on 1.86m shares, then 3.92.

findings.finding: The VQW-765 Phase III in social anxiety disorder failed on 2026-10-14 (primary p=0.89) and the program is on hold. Q2 R&D rose 68% to $37.0m, 'primarily due to higher expenses on our VQW-765' program. The release could therefore make management's 'opex begins decreasing by end of 2026, more substantially in 2027' statement more concrete. A quantified opex cut would help a cash-burn story.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior opex-cut print. The Q3 2025 guide carried higher SG&A and R&D and a lower cash guide, and the stock fell 20%, so the market has reacted to spend.
findings.why_not_priced: The failure itself is priced (-1.9% that day). Any savings would show only in the company's numbers, and no estimate update I found reflects them.

findings.finding: Cash and investments were $170.0m at 2026-06-30, down from $263.8m at year-end, with $81.3m of operating cash burn in H1. On that run rate Q3-end cash is about $130-140m against a market cap of about $236m (60.46m shares at $3.905). The company says cash funds operations 'through at least the end of 2027', but the 10-Q adds that without financing it 'may be required to reduce the scope of its future activities'. On what the money buys: the BYSANTI launch and NEREUS promotion, neither yet corroborated by revenue. So any softening of the runway language, or a new ATM or shelf, reads negative. No S-3 or 8-K has been filed since August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: year-end cash guide cut to $260-290m from $280-320m, -20.15% (alongside the revenue narrowing). Q1 2026: a $61.5m cash drop, -14.11%.
findings.why_not_priced: Enterprise value is already near $100m, so the market carries some of this. But the runway claim was reiterated in August and sell-side targets assume no dilution. A changed runway statement would be new.
findings.independence: Q1 call (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/06/vanda-vnda-q1-2026-earnings-call-transcript/): 2026 cash burn 'will be greater than' 2025. Shares the 10-Q with finding 1.

findings.finding: Positioning cuts against the negatives. About 13% of float is short with 6.5 days to cover (2026-09-30), short interest rose from 3.2m shares in March to 7.4-7.8m, the stock is at its 52-week low, and option open interest is call-heavy (put/call 0.10). A print that clears a low bar, or a guide cut smaller than feared, has a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (+0.59% on a large but explained miss) is the only flat-to-up print of the last seven. Six of seven were down, median absolute move 8.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public. This is an offset to the negatives, not a forecast that the market has missed something.
findings.independence: MarketBeat, 2026-03-13 short interest 3.2m shares, 1.7 days to cover (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/vanda-pharmaceuticals-inc-nasdaqvnda-short-interest-update-2026-03-29/). Option open interest from the sealed baseline.

rejected_candidates.detail: Neither the Q2 release nor the 10-Q gives a dollar stocking amount. The 10-Q says only that revenue was constrained, so the $15.2m figure is unsupported.
The company's 2026-10-21 release sets 2026-10-28 after the close (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/VNDA/vanda-pharmaceuticals-to-announce-third-quarter-2026-financial-rpqxb46dg5ch.html).

baseline_tension: No skew to fight, and the event move is large. The negative lean agrees with the 20-day run-up (-20%) and the name's habit of selling prints (6 of 7 down), so part of it is priced. The crowded short and call-heavy open interest cut against it, which is why p_up is 40 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short, about 13% of float, 6.5 days to cover): guidance finding -3.5 to -3.0, p_up 38 to 40 (shared with lesson 6)
Lesson 6 (revenue bar has a single source): reported-quarter finding capped, -1.5 to -1.0
Lesson 1 (this name has not rewarded positive pipeline readouts): NEREUS/DSPD finding +0.5 to +0.3
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the cash buys (BYSANTI and NEREUS launches, not yet corroborated by revenue), kept the runway finding at -1.0
Lessons 8 and 9 checked: the guide arithmetic is public, so the thin-coverage upsizing does not apply; the guide finding was already computed on total revenue, not only Fanapt
